title: Contrastive Analysis of Linguistic Representations in Large Language Model Outputs through Structured Synthetic Data Generation and Abstracted N-gram Associations

bias_targets.methodology: Contrastive text generation using minimal pairs of prompts specifying a disability (e.g., a blind person) versus a control group (e.g., a person wearing glasses). The model's outputs are analyzed by extracting n-grams, grouping them into semantic equivalence classes, and computing a Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) based 'BiasScore' to identify and rank text fragments containing differentially associated discursive patterns (e.g., inspirational porn).
